info.name: GitHub Create Reaction for Commit Comment

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the comment.

items.docs: Create a reaction to a [commit comment](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/commits/comments#get-a-commit-comment). response with an HTTP `200` status means that you already added the reaction type to this commit comment.
